actions.description: Atomic upstream switch and verify public endpoint
actions.command:
printf '8082' > /var/lib/rollout/.upstream.tmp && mv -T /var/lib/rollout/.upstream.tmp /var/lib/rollout/upstream && cat /var/lib/rollout/upstream; echo
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/health; echo
  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/version; echo
  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/customer-alpha-73c; echo
  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/customer-beta-a19; echo
done
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'put: %{http_code}\n' -X PUT -d 'post-switch-value' http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/post-switch
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/post-switch; echo
